#Make a plot, one plot for each CF as a facet
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# ---------------------------
# 1. Read and wrangle data
# ---------------------------

cf_data <- read_delim(
  "/Users/xvoast/Documents/Projects/Review_CFs_2026/CF_analyses_R/data/CF_data.csv",
  delim = ";",
  col_types = cols()
)

# Check the data
print(cf_data)

# Convert from wide to long format
cf_long <- cf_data %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -CF,
    names_to = "year",
    values_to = "prevalence"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(year),
    prevalence = as.numeric(prevalence),
    CF = str_replace_all(CF, "_", "/")
  ) %>%
  arrange(CF, year)

# Check result
print(cf_long)

# ---------------------------
# 2. Faceted plot:
#    one panel per CF
# ---------------------------

p_facets <- ggplot(cf_long, aes(x = year, y = prevalence, group = CF)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ CF, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Fluctuation in ETEC colonization factor prevalence over time",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Prevalence (%)"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

print(p_facets)

# Save if wanted
ggsave("CF_faceted_plot.png", p_facets, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)

# ---------------------------
# 3. Combined plot:
#    all CFs in one panel
# ---------------------------

p_all <- ggplot(cf_long, aes(x = year, y = prevalence, color = CF, group = CF)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Prevalence of ETEC colonization factors over time",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Prevalence (%)",
    color = "CF"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

print(p_all)

# Save if wanted
ggsave("CF_all_in_one_plot.png", p_all, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

#Other plots
```{r}
# Data for end labels

cf_labels <- cf_long %>%
  group_by(CF) %>%
  filter(year == max(year)) %>%
  ungroup()

p_all_labels <- ggplot(cf_long, aes(x = year, y = prevalence, group = CF, color = CF)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_text(
    data = cf_labels,
    aes(label = CF),
    hjust = -0.1,
    size = 3,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = sort(unique(cf_long$year)),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.12))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Prevalence of ETEC colonization factors over time",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Prevalence (%)"
  ) +

  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
print(p_all_labels)

ggsave("CF_all_in_one_plot_labels.png", p_all_labels, width = 11, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```
# Barplot instead
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# ---------------------------
# 1. Read and wrangle data
# ---------------------------

cf_data <- read_delim(
  "CF_data.csv",
  delim = ";",
  col_types = cols()
)

cf_long <- cf_data %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -CF,
    names_to = "year",
    values_to = "prevalence"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(year),
    prevalence = as.numeric(prevalence),
    CF = str_replace_all(CF, "_", "/")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(prevalence)) %>%
  arrange(CF, year)

print(cf_long)

# ---------------------------
# 2. Faceted bar plot
#    one panel per CF
# ---------------------------

p_faceted_bar <- ggplot(cf_long, aes(x = factor(year), y = prevalence)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ CF, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Prevalence of ETEC colonization factors over time",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Prevalence (%)"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

print(p_faceted_bar)

ggsave("CF_faceted_barplot.png", p_faceted_bar, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)

# ---------------------------
# 3. Optional:
#    add value labels
# ---------------------------

p_faceted_bar_labels <- ggplot(cf_long, aes(x = factor(year), y = prevalence)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = prevalence), vjust = -0.3, size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~ CF, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Prevalence of ETEC colonization factors over time",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Prevalence (%)"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

print(p_faceted_bar_labels)

ggsave("CF_faceted_barplot_labels.png", p_faceted_bar_labels, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```

#Heatmap instead
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# ---------------------------
# 1. Read data
# ---------------------------

cf_data <- read_delim(
  "/Users/xvoast/Documents/Projects/Review_CFs_2026/CF_analyses_R/data/CF_data.csv",
  delim = ";",
  col_types = cols()
)

# ---------------------------
# 2. Reshape
# ---------------------------

cf_long <- cf_data %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -CF,
    names_to = "year",
    values_to = "prevalence"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    prevalence = as.numeric(prevalence),
    year = factor(year, levels = unique(year)),
    CF = str_replace_all(CF, "_", "/")
  )

# ---------------------------
# 3. Order CFs (optional but nice)
# ---------------------------

cf_order <- cf_long %>%
  group_by(CF) %>%
  summarise(mean_prev = mean(prevalence, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_prev)) %>%
  pull(CF)

cf_long <- cf_long %>%
  mutate(CF = factor(CF, levels = cf_order))

# ---------------------------
# 4. Heatmap (clean version)
# ---------------------------

p_heatmap <- ggplot(cf_long, aes(x = year, y = CF, fill = prevalence)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "white",
    high = "black",
    name = "Prevalence (%)"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Prevalence of ETEC colonization factors across studies",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Colonization factor"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

p_heatmap <- ggplot(cf_long, aes(x = year, y = CF, fill = prevalence)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "white",
    high = "black",
    name = "Prevalence (%)"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Colonization factor"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

print(p_heatmap)

ggsave("/Users/xvoast/Documents/Projects/Review_CFs_2026/CF_analyses_R/CF_heatmap.png", p_heatmap, width = 5, height = 3, dpi = 300)
```
